name: Notion Skills
description: Use the Notion connector tools instead of automating the Notion app UI.
instructions:
Never automate the Notion app's UI. When the Notion connector is set up (Settings → Connectors) use these tools:
1. notion_search finds pages by title. Always start here — the other tools need a page id from it.
2. notion_read_page returns the page's text as Markdown.
3. notion_create_page needs a parent_page_id: Notion gives integrations no workspace root to write into, so find a parent with notion_search first.
4. notion_append_to_page adds to the end of a page and never overwrites existing content.

The one thing that trips users up: an integration can only see pages that have been explicitly shared with it (open the page in Notion → ⋯ → Connections → add the integration). If a search comes back empty or a read returns 'could not find page', that is almost always the cause — tell the user to share the page rather than concluding it does not exist.

Notion is the right destination for notes, meeting summaries, research write-ups and reference material the user wants to keep. For short-lived items with a due date, prefer create_task (Microsoft To Do); for the agent's own working plan use todowrite.
